mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, /* comment_parent_id(VARCHAR) → Long 매핑을 위해 CAST */ CAST(c.comment_parent_id AS SIGNED) AS parentId, c.mbr_cd, m.mbr_nicknm, c.comment_ctnt, c.comment_reg_date, c.comment_status, m.mbr_profile FROM comment c LEFT JOIN member m ON m.mbr_cd = c.mbr_cd WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND (c.comment_status IS NULL OR c.comment_status != 'DELETE') ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(c.comment_parent_id,''), c.comment_id+0), c.comment_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, CAST(NULLIF(c.comment_parent_id, '') AS SIGNED) AS commentParentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.mbr_cd AS mbrCd, c.comment_ctnt AS commentCtnt, m.mbr_nknm AS authorNickname, m.mbr_profile AS mbrProfile, c.comment_reg_date AS commentRegDate FROM comment c JOIN member m ON m.mbr_cd = c.mbr_cd WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.comment_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.comment_parent_id IS NULL OR c.comment_parent_id = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.comment_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, comment_parent_id, mbr_cd, comment_ctnt, comment_reg_date, comment_status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{mbrCd, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{commentCtnt}, NOW(), 'ACTIVE')
